title: Coordinate one whole change gate after implementation
statement: The Skill procedures Module shall coordinate one whole change gate after implementation within its accountable boundary so that SR-082 can be satisfied without transferring another owner's decisions or state authority.

what.problem: The SR-082 obligation crosses guidance, governance or publication boundaries; an unowned contribution can make a locally valid step appear sufficient for the whole workflow.
what.desired_outcome: Continue eligible authorized milestones after required checks without mandatory milestone review handoffs.

why.rationale: MOD-012 owns the behavior or state needed for this contribution; separating it preserves one accountable owner while allowing the parent SR to compose several contributors.

stakeholders: Authors, reviewers and project decision owners

conditions: When the selected requirement-first workflow exercises SR-082 or reassesses its affected basis.

contexts: The MOD-012 responsibility boundary and its declared logical Interfaces.

how.approach: Apply the allocated criteria through the constrained Functions and explicit contract inputs/outcomes; preserve actual actor decisions, subject identity and known limitations.

how_much.scope: This allocated contribution to SR-082; other contributors, independent assessment, physical recording implementation and product activation remain distinct.

acceptance_criteria: Continue eligible authorized milestones after required checks without mandatory milestone review handoffs.
Send complete implementation, including cross-milestone interactions, to one formal whole-change gate; advisory feedback and a last-milestone-only review cannot substitute.
Route corrections within the same gate and require current adequate approval before final Verify; isolated scope and optional PR authority remain bounded.
assumptions: The selected project contract, scope and required counterpart contributions are identifiable; absence is reported rather than inferred.
constraints: This draft allocation neither activates replacement runtime contracts nor proves implementation or satisfaction.

sources.basis: Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.
